summary: Fewer than half of laid-off workers get written notice ahead of time.
realLife: The survey found about 45 percent had written advance notice; plant closings had the most (about 58 percent), then abolished positions (about 42) and too little work (about 32).
sources: Bureau of Labor Statistics, Worker Displacement news release (Jan 2023 to Dec 2025): https://www.bls.gov/news.release/disp.nr0.htm
inGame: Job-ended event could carry a notice flag by reason; no notice or WARN records exist, so it needs: advance-notice field on the job-ended event.
